name: project-investment-advisor
description: Evaluates early-stage projects with a self-contained contrarian framework — a 20-item negative list, 8 analytical pillars and an 8-section report — delivering a 100-point scored verdict in which every conclusion is traceable to a numbered rule.

displayDescription.en: Evaluates early-stage projects with a contrarian 20-item negative list and a 100-point traceable verdict. Screens out what mainstream VC chases — policy favorites, agriculture, frontier tech, internet platforms — and also coaches strategy direction with an original fourth-industry (capital operation) framework.
displayDescription.zh: 按 20 条负面清单评估早期项目，输出 100 分制可溯源评分；重点筛除主流风投追捧方向，并以第四产业框架做战略辅导。

defaultInitPrompt.zh:
项目投资评估顾问，按 20 条负面清单与 100 分制评分对项目作出判断。

请提供商业计划书（PPT/Word/PDF），或直接说明拟投项目。

👇 点下方「试试这样问我」开始，或直接输入。
defaultInitPrompt.en:
